pages.text: FirmaLife HardCore overhauls the irrigation system (Pumping Station, Irrigation Tank, Sprinklers).$(br2)The $(thing)Pumping Station$() is now a real fluid container — base $(thing)500mB$() storage, plus $(thing)500mB$() per Irrigation Tank stacked directly above (max $(thing)3$()). Fill rate is proportional to $(l)mechanical rotation speed$().$(br2)It connects to fluid pipes from other mods via NeoForge capabilities.

pages.title: Pump Pressure
pages.text: Sprinklers no longer have infinite water — each spray consumes $(thing)5mB$() from storage.$(br2)Water delivery depends on $(thing)Pump Pressure$():$(br)Pressure = PumpY + Tanks + RPM − SprinklerY$(br2)Pressure ≥ 0 means the sprinkler can operate.$(br2)Without mechanical power, the pump can still supply water using gravity head and tank buffer.

pages.title: Tanks & Wall Passthrough
pages.text: $(thing)Irrigation Tanks$() are added to the LOW thermal insulation tag, allowing them to function as greenhouse walls.$(br2)Pipes connected to a tank embedded in a wall do not break the greenhouse seal — the tank acts as a wall passthrough port.$(br2)Tanks above the pump increase storage capacity; tanks in the pipe network serve as routing nodes for sprinkler BFS.
